decisions.method: Public item metadata API, then each named unrestricted PDF and host OCR file. Sequential bounded retrieval, one-second spacing between content files; no search crawl or account access.
decisions.rightsBasis: Identified 1903 and 1915 printed editions; existing edition text-rights findings supplemented by inspected scan witnesses. US public-domain historical text; modern host material not included in that conclusion.
decisions.result: Four content files and two metadata provenance files retained. Host size and MD5, local SHA-256, PDF readability, contents and chapter starts checked. No public redistribution or full-text search ingestion.

decisions.scope: One Calvin volume index, three contents pages, and selected manually read commentary passages
decisions.method: Four explicitly named bibliographic pages retrieved with at least ten seconds between requests; no recursive corpus crawl. Selected body passages read through web research; public outputs retain metadata and short editorial descriptions only.
decisions.rightsBasis: CCEL permits educational/nonprofit use but directs republication requests to the host. Robots response on this date specified a ten-second general crawl delay and no general disallow; it is an access signal, not a content license.
decisions.result: 45 volume links and three bounded section inventories. Private HTML evidence retained under .local; no full commentary corpus downloaded or republished.

decisions.scope: Two Gill verse entries and commentary identity
decisions.method: Manual source reading and bibliographic links only; no crawling or page mirroring.
decisions.rightsBasis: Historical Gill text is distinct from the contemporary website and its additions; underlying print witness remains unidentified for this manifestation. Link-only records avoid assuming a host-file reuse grant.
decisions.result: One work/edition holding and two selected passage records; no copied content assets.

decisions.method: Publisher destination and authorized Logos/Biblia limited-preview bibliography; no purchase, login or retrieval of restricted chapters.
decisions.rightsBasis: Preview states copyright 1950, with April 1994 printing and reserved reproduction rights. This edition is not treated as public domain.
decisions.result: Publisher link, edition facts and seven chapter navigation records. Full text not acquired; chapters remain contents-only.
